::: {.hero-copy}
I develop deep-learning models for scientific problems involving structure and uncertainty. My current research focuses on predictive and generative models for RNA structure.

I study how these models learn structural representations, generalize to less familiar sequences, and represent multiple plausible solutions.

::: {.hero-actions}
[Explore my research](research.qmd){.button-primary}

:::

## Questions Guiding My Work

::: {.work-grid}
::: {.work-item}
### [Learning Structural Representations](research.qmd)

How can neural models capture the relationships between RNA sequence and secondary structure?
:::

::: {.work-item}
### [Generating Plausible Alternatives](research.qmd#generating-rna-structural-ensembles)

When a sequence admits more than one structure, how can generative models represent that diversity?
:::

::: {.work-item}
### [Understanding Generalization](research.qmd#evaluating-generalization-in-rna-prediction)

How does performance change as test sequences become less similar to the data used for training?
:::
:::

## Teaching

Alongside my research, I teach Neural Networks I and II in the Artificial Intelligence Engineering program. [See my academic activity](academic-activity.qmd).
